summary.headline: Preface on Roman Codices
summary.text: Preface to the catalogue’s Roman codices, describing coverage of Greek astrological writings in the Vallicelliana, Casanatense, Angelica, National, Chigi, and Vatican libraries, with only nine Vatican codices included and excerpts published in an appendix. The preface acknowledges assistance from colleagues and begins discussing the “Mysteries” of Apomasar.
